comparative_prior_art: Franklin et al. 2022 J Anim Ecol 10.1111/1365-2656.13697: timing repeatability known across 47 species
Asian houbara 2021 PMC8285904: individual temperature cue consistency already demonstrated
interpretation: Within-year year-normalized departure deviations retain repeatable bird-ID signatures. This rejects a fully bird-ID exchangeable yearly calendar null, but is compatible with annual scheduling plus persistent individual offsets, routes or social grouping; does not identify climate cue feedback or demographic fitness. Stage5 stronger than stage3 not established by direct contrast.
status_bounds: POST_EXPOSURE_EXPLORATORY: five stages and correlations examined before this formal test; no preregistration or biological causal claim.
